title: Acpilot agent manifest
description: `agents.toml`, the file that tells Acpilot what an agent is and how to start it. One `[[agents]]` block per agent; `transport` decides which fields that block may carry. The file is TOML — this schema describes it, it does not replace it — and an editor reads it from the `$schema` key or a `#:schema` first line.
$comment: Apache-2.0. Generated from crates/acpilot-agent/src/manifest.rs by `cargo xtask schema`; edit the Rust, not this file. This is the v1 document and is frozen: a change a `schema_version = 1` loader would read differently ships as agents-v2.json.

$schema.description: This document, so an editor can complete and check the file. Ignored by the loader.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema major version; `1` is the only one this build speaks.

agents.description: Every agent in the profile. May not be empty: delete the file instead of emptying it.

id.description:
Stable identifier: lowercase letters, digits, `-`, and `_`, starting with
a letter or digit, at most 64 characters, unique within the profile.

description.description: One sentence on what the agent is for.

transport.description: How the daemon drives it: `acp-stdio`, `pty`, or `http-jsonrpc`.

command.description:
`acp-stdio` and `pty`: the executable, resolved on the host the workspace
lives on.

env.description:
`acp-stdio` and `pty`: environment for the child. A value is a literal
(`NO_COLOR = "1"`) or a `keyring:<name>` reference, resolved when the
profile loads.

restart.description: What the supervisor does when the process dies. Defaults to `never`.

allow_cross_profile.description: Required before a `keyring:<profile>/<name>` reference is accepted.

prompt_row.description:
`pty`: text that identifies the input row, so chrome above it can be cut
away.

sentinel.description: `pty`: the input row back at rest — the primary turn-complete signal.

exit_command.description:
`pty`: what to type to leave cleanly (for example `/exit`); `Ctrl-D` is
not universal.

submit_delay_ms.description:
`pty`: gap between the text and the Enter key, in milliseconds. 50 by
default, because one write of `text\r` is a paste rather than a submit in
at least one TUI.

idle_timeout_ms.description:
`pty`: backstop when the sentinel does not fire, in milliseconds. 5000 by
default; `0` is refused.

Restart.description: What the supervisor does when an agent's process dies.

oneOf.description:
Leave it dead and report it. The default: the examples write
`on-crash` where they mean it, so restarting silently would be a
surprise nobody asked for.
Restart it, up to the attempt limit the supervisor owns (three tries).
